checks.note: NTP is disabled on the BMC. Configure NTP servers to avoid time-skew issues in VCF.

checks.label: Non-UTC Offset (-07:00)
checks.note: BMC uses local timezone offset -07:00 (VCF requires UTC across all BMCs). Set BMC timezone to UTC to prevent certificate validation and authentication failures. Remediation: (Dell) racadm set iDRAC.Time.Timezone UTC | (HPE) set /system1/timezone UTC

checks.label: Time Drift Detected (18m 24s skew)
checks.note: BMC clock differs from scan time by 18m 24s (includes 420m timezone offset -07:00) (BMC time: 2026-09-30T14:39:44-07:00). Correct BMC time/NTP and verify UTC timezone to prevent VCF certificate and authentication failures.

memory_topology.status_badge: 🔴 Degraded Memory Topology (67% Efficiency)
issues: Sub-Optimal Memory Interleaving on Socket 1: 4 of 6 channels active (4 DIMMs). Memory bus operating at ~67% bandwidth capacity.
Sub-Optimal Memory Interleaving on Socket 2: 4 of 6 channels active (4 DIMMs). Memory bus operating at ~67% bandwidth capacity.
recommendations: Install 2 additional DIMM(s) on Socket 1 in empty channels to enable full 6-channel interleaving.
Install 2 additional DIMM(s) on Socket 2 in empty channels to enable full 6-channel interleaving.
